title: Meeting mode

permissions: Automation: Slack, WhatsApp, Discord, Messages, Telegram (asked once per app the first time it is quit)

steps.dry_run: mute the sound, quit running chat apps (Slack, WhatsApp, Discord, Messages, Telegram), and open a meeting link from a Calendar event happening now or starting within 15 minutes, and turn on Do Not Disturb if a Shortcut named "Friday Focus On" exists

undo: unmute the sound and reopen the chat apps
